children.text: Test copy channel called Blade and Quill Art Academy. New YouTube videos are created usually bi-weekly.
I am a French author and illustrator. This website is about digital art.

I am the creator of Lheeloo & Luna, a charming illustrated cartoon book. I specialize in chibi-style cartoons, character designs, and digital painting in Krita. Whether you're just starting out or looking to refine your technique, Blade & Quill is your creative home.
